Client work

Selected courses, platforms, videos, interfaces and learning-related applications. Open any item to see the brief, my contribution and the result.

Courses and learning

  • CBRE

    myBuy Training

    CBRE was introducing Coupa as myBuy. I developed task-based system simulations in Show Me, Try Me and Test Me modes, giving staff a chance to practise before go-live. I also coordinated the French adaptation.

    Open myBuy Training

  • UNECE

    Sustainable Inland Transport Connectivity Indicators (SITCIN) module

    UNECE needed government officials to understand its transport-connectivity indicator framework. I designed and wrote a self-paced course of up to 180 minutes, including interactive content and AI-assisted media. The programme was prepared in English and adapted for French and Russian audiences.

    Open Sustainable Inland Transport Connectivity Indicators (SITCIN) module

  • OSCE

    Online Security Management course

    I designed a seven-module OSCE security-management course, built the modules in Storyline and published them to TalentLMS. The reusable course template also supported later development.

    Open Online Security Management course

  • KPMG

    Client Management Overview

    KPMG UK moved its staff to Microsoft Dynamics CRM. Working inside the change team, I built role-based e-learning, job aids and videos, so each group learned the part of the system it uses.

    Open Client Management Overview

  • Clarksons

    Trainee Broker Programme

    Clarksons, a company of 1,379 staff in 46 offices worldwide, needed one licence programme for trainee shipbrokers. I built 20 units of competency with assessments and interactive visual aids.

    Open Trainee Broker Programme

  • NSW Community Services

    Keep Them Safe (KTS) Reforms Programme

    NSW Community Services needed online training for NGO staff on the major child-protection law changes in the Keep Them Safe reforms. I built all nine modules of the programme in Adobe Captivate, with case studies to practise on. The demo is Module 1, the overview.

    Open Keep Them Safe (KTS) Reforms Programme

Platforms and websites

  • UNECE

    UNECE eTIR Website

    Customs authorities and transport associations needed clear, role-specific guidance on the eTIR system. I scoped, designed and built the Drupal website with the OSCE and UNECE, including a searchable documentation structure and administrator handover.

    Open UNECE eTIR Website

  • UNECE

    UNECE SITCIN Website

    UNECE asked for a public-site redesign. The audit revealed a deeper problem: officials could not complete an assessment reliably. I redesigned the focal point experience and rebuilt the core Drupal workflow, added new indicators and supported a three-country pilot. Live since June 2026.

    Open UNECE SITCIN Website

  • Advanced Learning World

    Advanced Learning World platform

    Advanced Learning World is a bilingual, mentor-led platform for Saudi K-12 students, built on Open edX with a custom front end. As Learning Technology Lead and Solution Architect, I represented the client across content, UX, platform requirements and testing, working with delivery partner EPAM.

    Open Advanced Learning World platform

    Advanced Learning Company website

    The Advanced Learning Company website supported the learning business and its product launch. I helped define the structure, design the pages and build the website in 2016, then updated it for the 2020 platform release.
